public.title: Search a 2D Matrix
public.description: Rows form a rectangular integer matrix. Each row is increasing and each later row starts after the previous row ends. Return whether target occurs. Dimensions are 0 to 100; values and target are between -10000 and 10000.
hints: Treat the matrix as a sorted flat array.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Binary search maps a flat index to row and column. Time O(log(rows times columns)), extra space O(1).
